P&BB depends on assisted-channel platforms that are reliable, intuitive and able to evolve with employee and customer needs. This role will define how those platforms advance over time, how resiliency priorities are established and how change is introduced and sustained across the frontline.

This is a strategic and execution-focused mandate. The role connects near-term stability and employee-experience needs with longer-term platform modernization, ensuring that incidents, operational insights, adoption results and frontline feedback influence priorities and investment decisions.

The Director leads three integrated functions: Assisted Channels Platform Strategy and Resiliency, Organizational Change Management for Digital Employee Platforms, and BTE.

– Vice President Finance

Do you want your next role to provide a significant opportunity to build a lasting legacy, not just maintain someone else’s creation? Are you motivated by transforming finance from a reporting function into a strategic growth engine? Can you turn complex data into clarity for a leadership team, Board and Private Equity owners?

We are seeking a highly strategic and commercially minded Vice President, Finance to join the Executive Leadership Team and help shape the future of one of Canada's leading sales, merchandising, experiential marketing, and retail workforce solutions organizations.

With a team more than 2,000 strong supporting some of the world's most recognized consumer brands across Canada, Brand Momentum has built its reputation on exceptional service, strong execution, and long-standing client relationships. As the business continues to scale, the organization is looking for a finance leader who can elevate finance from a traditional reporting function into a strategic driver of performance, profitability, and growth.

The Mandate

This is more than a finance leadership role – it is a build opportunity. The mandate for the incoming Vice President, Finance is to transform the finance function into a proactive business partner that drives strategic decision-making, operational excellence, and enterprise value creation.

Over the next 12–24 months, the successful candidate will:
Establish a best-in-class planning, forecasting, and performance management framework
Improve the speed and quality of financial reporting
Build out meaningful FP&A capabilities
Strengthen visibility into customer and service-line profitability
Develop KPI dashboards that support operational decision-making
Lead the implementation, integration, and optimization of a new ERP system, ensuring it delivers stronger integration, reporting, forecasting, and operational visibility

Leadership and Stewardship

This role calls for more than a finance executive – it calls for a business leader who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. The right candidate is equally comfortable working through detailed financial information, coaching their team, collaborating with operational leaders, presenting to executives, and helping solve day-to-day business challenges.

Beyond technical expertise, we are seeking a commercially minded business leader with an ownership mentality – someone who enjoys building capabilities, influencing outcomes, challenging the status quo, and creating measurable business impact.

This is a rare opportunity to join a respected Canadian market leader, partner closely with an accomplished executive leadership team and experienced private equity investors and play a central role in the company's next phase of growth. You will have the opportunity to influence strategic decisions at the highest levels of the organization, gain meaningful exposure to the Board and ownership group, and leave a lasting legacy by building a finance function designed to support long-term success.

If you are a commercially driven finance executive who thrives in growth environments and is excited by the opportunity to build, lead, and influence, we would welcome the opportunity to connect.

The Role

This cross-functional role will work across the organisation to identify opportunities, modernise systems, redesign processes and embed effective AI-enabled ways of working.

Data Science & Advanced Analytics

Evaluate analytical approaches and outputs, identify limitations and opportunities, and ensure that methodologies are rigorous, actionable, and connected to client objectives.

Complex Program & Engagement Leadership

Strategic Analytics & Client Advisory

Serve as a senior analytics partner to clients and internal stakeholders, helping frame ambiguous business questions into analytical problems that can be solved with data.

Team & Technical Leadership

Lead and develop analytics and data science talent, set expectations for analytical quality, and provide guidance on methodologies and approaches across multiple workstreams.

Partner effectively with data scientists, analysts, media teams, strategists, engineers, and other specialists to deliver integrated solutions.

Early Account Economics

Client Advisory & Growth

Build credible senior client relationships and identify opportunities where analytics, data science, measurement, or AI capabilities can address additional client needs.

AI-Enabled Delivery & Innovation

Identify qualified AI use cases and opportunities to incorporate AI-enabled approaches into analytics and measurement. Help evaluate where emerging technologies can create measurable value rather than applying AI for its own sake.

Ability to evaluate and guide sophisticated analytical work, including methodology, assumptions, limitations, and business implications
